desc.zh: 注意力和序列模型直接从用户的历史行为里学兴趣，序列越拉越长。
desc.en: Attention and sequence models learn interests straight from a user's history, and the history keeps getting longer.

desc.zh: 推荐任务被写成文字提示或语义编码，交给语言模型逐个生成，不再只是打分。
desc.en: Recommendation tasks become text prompts or Semantic IDs that a language model generates token by token, not just scores.

desc.zh: 推荐模型测出清楚的规模曲线：参数和算力加上去，效果跟着涨。
desc.en: Recommenders measure clear scaling curves: add parameters and compute, and quality follows.

name.zh: 一个模型接管整条链路
name.en: One model takes over the pipeline

desc.zh: 生成式模型替换召回加排序的级联并全量上线，规模收益开始在生产环境兑现。
desc.en: A generative model replaces the retrieve-then-rank cascade in production, and scaling gains start paying off for real.

desc.zh: 行为序列和其余特征进同一个 Transformer，上万条行为端到端进排序，规模定律被逐项测量。
desc.en: Behaviour sequences and every other feature share one Transformer, tens of thousands of behaviours go end to end into ranking, and scaling laws are measured one dimension at a time.

desc.zh: 推理要不要写出来、每个候选算多少、训练和服务各读多少，都按成本重新设计。
desc.en: Whether reasoning is written out, how much compute each candidate gets, how much is read in training versus serving: all redesigned around cost.

stops.title: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
stops.label: DIN

zh.s: 按候选物品给历史行为做注意力加权。

en.s: Attention over past behaviours, weighted by the candidate item.

stops.title: Deep Interest Evolution Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
stops.label: DIEN

zh.s: 用 GRU 建模兴趣随时间的变化。

en.s: Models how interests evolve over time with a GRU.

stops.title: Search-based User Interest Modeling with Lifelong Sequential Behavior Data for Click-Through Rate Prediction
stops.label: SIM

zh.s: 两阶段：先检索相关行为，再做精细注意力，序列做到上万条。

en.s: Two stages: retrieve relevant behaviours, then run fine attention; sequences reach tens of thousands.

stops.title: Recommendation as Language Processing (RLP): A Unified Pretrain, Personalized Prompt & Predict Paradigm (P5)
stops.label: P5

zh.s: 把评分、序列推荐、写解释等任务都写成文字提示，交给同一个语言模型。

en.s: Writes rating, sequential recommendation and explanation tasks as text prompts for one language model.

stops.title: TWIN: TWo-stage Interest Network for Lifelong User Behavior Modeling in CTR Prediction at Kuaishou
stops.label: TWIN

zh.s: 让检索阶段和精排阶段用同一种相关性度量。

en.s: Makes the retrieval and ranking stages use the same relevance measure.

stops.title: Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval
stops.label: TIGER

zh.s: 给每个物品编一串语义编码（Semantic ID），推荐变成逐个生成这串编码，不再查向量索引。

en.s: Gives each item a Semantic ID and recommends by generating that code token by token.

stops.title: Scaling Law of Large Sequential Recommendation Models
stops.label: Scaling SR

zh.s: 较早系统测量序列推荐模型的规模定律。

en.s: An early systematic measurement of scaling laws for sequential recommenders.

stops.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
stops.label: HSTU

zh.s: 把召回和排序改写成对行为序列的生成式建模，第一次在推荐里看到清楚的规模效应。

en.s: Recasts retrieval and ranking as generative modelling of action sequences; the first clear scaling curve in recommendation.

stops.title: Wukong: Towards a Scaling Law for Large-Scale Recommendation
stops.label: Wukong

zh.s: 用堆叠的因子分解机做特征交互，跨两个数量级保持规模收益。

en.s: Stacked factorization machines for feature interaction, scaling across two orders of magnitude.

stops.title: TWIN V2: Scaling Ultra-Long User Behavior Sequence Modeling for Enhanced CTR Prediction at Kuaishou
stops.label: TWIN V2

zh.s: 用层次聚类压缩行为，序列做到用户整个生命周期。

en.s: Compresses behaviours with hierarchical clustering to reach life-cycle-long sequences.

stops.title: OneRec: Unifying Retrieve and Rank with Generative Recommender and Iterative Preference Alignment
stops.label: OneRec

zh.s: 用一个生成模型替换召回加排序的级联，并按用户偏好继续对齐。

en.s: Replaces the retrieve-then-rank cascade with one generative model, then aligns it to user preferences.

stops.title: LONGER: Scaling Up Long Sequence Modeling in Industrial Recommenders
stops.label: LONGER

zh.s: 用全局 token 和 token 合并，把长序列端到端放进 Transformer。

en.s: Global tokens plus token merging put long sequences end to end into a Transformer.

stops.title: MTGR: Industrial-Scale Generative Recommendation Framework in Meituan
stops.label: MTGR

zh.s: 把排序换成 HSTU 结构但保留全部交叉特征，训练成本持平、订单量提升。
zh.dive_note: 本站深度解读读的是美团技术博客版（2025-05），不是 arXiv 版。
zh.quote: 结果是单样本前向推理的计算量（博客的口径是线上给一个候选打一次分）涨到原来的 65 倍，训练成本却和原模型持平，外卖首页列表订单量提升 1.22%，团队称这是近两年单次优化里最大的收益。

en.s: Switches ranking to the HSTU architecture while keeping all cross features; training cost stays flat.
en.dive_note: Our deep dive covers the Meituan tech-blog version (2025-05), not the arXiv paper.

stops.title: OneRec Technical Report
stops.label: OneRec TR

zh.s: 端到端生成式推荐在短视频主场景全量上线，并公开了算力和收益账本。

en.s: End-to-end generative recommendation fully deployed in the main short-video feed, with its compute and gains published.

stops.title: Realizing Scaling Laws in Recommender Systems: A Foundation-Expert Paradigm for Hyperscale Model Deployment
stops.label: 基础+专家

zh.s: 大基础模型加各场景专家模型，让规模收益能真正上线。
zh.quote: 将超大规模基础模型真正部署到生产环境面临三大核心挑战

en.s: A large foundation model plus per-surface expert models, so scaling gains can actually ship.

stops.title: OneRec-Think: In-Text Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
stops.label: OneRec-Think

zh.s: 让模型先用文字写推理，再输出要推荐的物品。

en.s: The model writes out its reasoning first, then outputs the items to recommend.

stops.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
stops.label: OneTrans

zh.s: 把用户行为序列和其余特征切成同一串 token，交给一个 Transformer 一起算。
zh.quote: OneTransS 在与 RankMixer+Transformer（2.51T FLOPs）相近计算量下，性能全面超越，说明统一建模本身比堆叠独立模块更高效。

en.s: Behaviour sequences and every other feature become one token sequence for a single Transformer.

stops.title: Make It Long, Keep It Fast: End-to-End 10K Long User Behavior Sequence Modeling for Billion-Scale Douyin Recommendation
stops.label: 10K 序列

zh.s: 1 万条行为端到端进排序，算力约降到十一分之一。
zh.quote: self-attention 在 L=10k 需要 236.26 GFLOPs，而本文方法只需 21.06 GFLOPs

en.s: 10K behaviours end to end in ranking at roughly one eleventh of the compute.

stops.title: LLaTTE: Scaling Laws for Multi-Stage Sequence Modeling in Large-Scale Ads Recommendation
stops.label: LLaTTE

zh.s: 测量多阶段序列模型在各个维度上的幂律。
zh.quote: 各缩放维度的幂律关系均得到验证

en.s: Measures power laws along every scaling dimension of multi-stage sequence models.

stops.title: MixFormer: Co-Scaling Up Dense and Sequence in Industrial Recommenders
stops.label: MixFormer

zh.s: 序列建模和稠密特征交互共享参数，一起放大。
zh.quote: 论文认为这种 rigid separation 会造成 co-scaling 失配：序列模块计算随长度快速增长，占据预算后压缩 dense 模块扩容；反过来，如果优先扩 dense 特征交互，又无法利用长序列。

en.s: Sequence modelling and dense feature interaction share parameters and scale together.

stops.title: UxSID: Semantic-Aware User Interests Modeling for Ultra-Long Sequence
stops.label: UxSID

zh.s: 按候选的语义编码分组，同组候选共用一份离线算好的用户兴趣，线上只查一次表。
zh.quote: 快手工业数据上 CTCVR AUC 从 TWIN 的 0.8609 提到 0.8626，一周广告 A/B 收入涨 0.337%，线上延迟只多 0.16 毫秒。

en.s: Groups candidates by Semantic ID; each group shares one offline-computed user interest, served with a single lookup.

stops.title: Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences
stops.label: 行为基础模型

zh.s: 给行为基础模型一份类似 Chinchilla 的算力配比指南。
zh.quote: 这类行为基础模型缺少 Chinchilla 式的算力标定指南

en.s: A Chinchilla-style compute allocation guide for behavioural foundation models.

stops.title: Teacher Retains Full Tokens, Student Merges Efficiently: TM20K for E-Commerce Sequence Modeling in Ad Recommendation
stops.label: TM20K

zh.s: 教师模型完整读 2 万条行为，再把长序列知识蒸馏给会合并 token 的学生模型。
zh.quote: 论文在 ByteDance 的广告推荐场景测量到：从 5K 扩展到 20K，训练时间约为 3.5 倍，GPU 显存增加 49G，线上服务延迟约为 6.3 倍。

en.s: A teacher reads all 20K behaviours, then distils the long-sequence knowledge into a token-merging student.

stops.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
stops.label: Densing Law

zh.s: 行为数据大量重复，规模加到头后，转向提高用户表示的“密度”。
zh.quote: 继续扩大用户数、观察窗口或 encoder 参数，训练损失还会下降，下游表示质量却趋于平台。

en.s: Behaviour data repeats so much that scaling stalls; the paper turns to the density of user representations instead.

stops.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
stops.label: SequenceO1

zh.s: 10 万条行为先压成每个用户一份缓存摘要，所有候选共用。
zh.quote: 在抖音上线一个月，用它替换原来的终身兴趣模块后，完播提升 2.33%，不喜欢下降 6.98%。
zh.hoot_t: 谁来分权重：兴趣槽挑行为，还是行为分给兴趣槽
zh.hoot: 普通注意力由兴趣槽挑行为，冷门行为只分到 0.26；Sketch Attention 里每条行为自己分出 1 份，冷门的也是 1。

en.s: Compresses up to 100K behaviours into one cached per-user summary shared by all candidates.

stops.title: OneTrans-V2: Unifying Retrieval, Pre-rank, and Fine-rank with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
stops.label: OneTrans-V2

zh.s: 三个阶段变成同一个 Transformer 的三个任务，用户历史只编码一次。
zh.quote: 在一个大型工业推荐系统上，它替换原有的三模型级联后，人均 GMV 提升 9.74%，同样硬件下整条链路的 QPS 是原来的 3.2 倍。
zh.hoot_t: 把 β 从 0 往上拉，变的只是“走哪个前缀”
zh.hoot: 广告前缀从 β=0 的 0.33 平滑升到 β=1 的 0.57，β=0.7 时两者打平；每个前缀下面生成哪些商品，一点不变。

en.s: Retrieval, pre-ranking and ranking become three tasks of one Transformer; user history is encoded once.

stops.title: Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction
stops.label: Predictable Scaling

zh.s: 用小模型可靠地预测某个改动放到大模型上是好是坏。
zh.quote: 它要节省的是模型研发的试验成本，而不是宣称把线上模型直接压缩后还能维持同样效果。

en.s: Uses small models to reliably predict whether a change helps at large scale.

stops.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
stops.label: OneLatent

zh.s: 把先写推理再出 SID 压成 3 个固定的隐式 token，上线不再生成推理文字。
zh.quote: 在快手本地生活工业数据上，OneLatent 的 SID@64 是 0.1993，比先写推理再作答的 OneReason-CoT 高 17.44%，推理吞吐是显式推理的 17.49 倍，和不推理的直接预测基本相同。
zh.hoot_t: 同一组 token ID，为什么能装下不同用户的推理
zh.hoot: 3 个潜在 token 对谁都一样，但走到这 3 个位置时注意力读到的是各自的上下文，SID 读的是这些隐状态。

en.s: Compresses write-the-reasoning-then-the-SID into three fixed latent tokens; no reasoning text at serving time.

stops.title: PinGER: Token-Efficient Generative Retrieval with Semantic IDs
stops.label: PinGER

zh.s: 训练时多看、服务时少读，让 SID 召回的输入成本降到向量召回的水平。
zh.quote: 这篇最值得借鉴的是“训练时多看、服务时少读、两者计算同一个函数”的掩码思路，它让 SID 召回在不牺牲监督信号的前提下拿到了向量召回的输入成本。
zh.hoot_t: 掩码长什么样，kernel 又怎么切
zh.hoot: 对角线以下每一块都有稠密列，FlexAttention 一块也跳不掉。

en.s: Sees more in training and reads less in serving, bringing SID retrieval input cost down to embedding-retrieval levels.

desc.zh: 语言模型先查文档再回答，开始学着操作浏览器并给出引用。
desc.en: The language model looks up documents before answering, and starts driving a browser and citing sources.

desc.zh: 推理和检索交替进行，模型自己决定什么时候该再查一次。
desc.en: Reasoning and retrieval alternate, and the model decides for itself when to look something up again.

desc.zh: 推理模型在长思维链里自己搜索，多轮搜索用只看结果的强化学习训练出来。
desc.en: Reasoning models search inside long chains of thought, and multi-turn search is trained with outcome-only reinforcement learning.

desc.zh: 多步推理搬进隐空间，特征按需才查，检索 agent 要的是真正的检索控制力。
desc.en: Multi-step reasoning moves into latent space, features are fetched only on demand, and retrieval agents get real control over retrieval.

stops.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
stops.label: RAG

zh.s: 先检索文档再生成，把外部知识接进语言模型。

en.s: Retrieve documents before generating, plugging external knowledge into a language model.

stops.title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
stops.label: WebGPT

zh.s: 让模型操作浏览器搜索、给出引用，并用人类反馈训练。

en.s: The model drives a browser to search and cite, trained with human feedback.

stops.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
stops.label: ReAct

zh.s: 思考和调用搜索交替进行，搭起 agent 的基本循环。

en.s: Interleaves reasoning with search calls, setting up the basic agent loop.

stops.title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
stops.label: IRCoT

zh.s: 多跳问答里每推理一步就再检索一次。

en.s: In multi-hop QA, retrieves again after every reasoning step.

stops.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
stops.label: FLARE

zh.s: 模型没把握时才主动去检索。

en.s: Retrieves only when the model is unsure.

stops.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
stops.label: Self-RAG

zh.s: 用反思 token 让模型自己决定要不要检索、证据靠不靠谱。

en.s: Reflection tokens let the model decide whether to retrieve and judge the evidence.

stops.title: Search-o1: Agentic Search-Enhanced Large Reasoning Models
stops.label: Search-o1

zh.s: 推理模型在长思维链中途自己去搜索。

en.s: A reasoning model searches on its own in the middle of a long chain of thought.

stops.title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
stops.label: Search-R1

zh.s: 只用结果奖励的强化学习训练多轮搜索。

en.s: Trains multi-turn search with outcome-only reinforcement learning.

stops.title: DeepResearcher: Scaling Deep Research via Reinforcement Learning in Real-world Environments
stops.label: DeepResearcher

zh.s: 在真实网页环境里做强化学习，而不是本地语料。

en.s: Runs RL in the real web environment instead of a local corpus.

stops.title: WebThinker: Empowering Large Reasoning Models with Deep Research Capability
stops.label: WebThinker

zh.s: 推理模型边搜、边浏览、边写报告。

en.s: A reasoning model searches, browses and writes a report as it goes.

stops.title: ZeroSearch: Incentivize the Search Capability of LLMs without Searching
stops.label: ZeroSearch

zh.s: 用大模型模拟搜索引擎，省掉强化学习训练时调用真实搜索的成本。

en.s: Simulates the search engine with an LLM, saving the cost of real search calls during RL.

stops.title: R3-RAG: Learning Step-by-Step Reasoning and Retrieval for LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
stops.label: R3-RAG

zh.s: 用强化学习学会何时检索、检索什么、何时停。
zh.quote: 让 LLM 通过强化学习自主学习何时检索、检索什么、以及何时停止检索，而非遵循预设的工作流。

en.s: Learns with RL when to retrieve, what to retrieve and when to stop.

stops.title: LatentRAG: Latent Reasoning and Retrieval for Efficient Agentic RAG
stops.label: LatentRAG

zh.s: 把多步推理搬进隐空间，降低 agentic RAG 的延迟。
zh.quote: agentic RAG 的端到端延迟通常是 single-step RAG 的 8–10×

en.s: Moves multi-step reasoning into latent space to cut agentic RAG latency.

stops.title: Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Agentic Retrieval
stops.label: SIRA

zh.s: 主张检索 agent 要有真正的检索控制能力，而不是靠多轮检索加长上下文来补。
zh.quote: 主流 Agent 往往把检索器当成黑盒：发出一个查询、阅读片段、再依据片段中的实体与词汇改写下一轮查询。

en.s: Argues retrieval agents need real control over retrieval rather than many rounds plus long context.

stops.title: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
stops.label: AGR

zh.s: 生成式检索边生成编码，边按需调用工具查特征。
zh.quote: AGR 让生成式检索模型在需要时再查特征，而不是每次把用户的全部历史都读一遍。

en.s: Generative retrieval that calls tools to look up features only when needed while generating codes.
